prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1408; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a collision sustained while turning left, when the vehicle was struck from the side. The mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the cervical and lumbar strain reported. Initial complaints included neck stiffness, paraspinal tenderness, and low back pain with limited range of motion. Examination revealed some objective findings supporting soft tissue injury, including reduced cervical rotation and muscle guarding, while other orthopedic and neurological tests were within normal limits. No prior injury to the neck or low back is known from the history obtained. Care was delivered over twenty visits consisting of manual therapy, guided exercise, and home stretching instructions. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency reduced as symptoms improved and range of motion returned. Billing records reflect one charge per scheduled service with no duplicate entries. At discharge the patient was improving and was advised to continue a home program as needed.
